entries.zh: 祖父（父系一方，即父亲之父）
entries.en: paternal grandfather; grandfather on the father's side

entries.zh: 祖母（父系一方，即父亲之母）
entries.en: paternal grandmother; grandmother on the father's side
great-grandfather (the grandfathers further up the line)
entries.notes: 西语栏字面"官员的祖父"系对"太公"的意译式转写；汉字栏与两栏对音互证为曾祖父尊称

entries.zh: 太上皇（退位之君、今上之父）
entries.en: emperor emeritus, retired emperor (the former sovereign in the royal line)
entries.notes: 西语栏"国王的祖父"系意译式转写；"太上皇"为固定称号，汉字与对音互证明确

entries.zh: 兆头、征兆（吉凶之兆）；兼指占卜、法术之事
entries.en: omen, augury (good or bad); by extension divination and sorcery

entries.zh: 屯市（字面"囤市/集市"之义，与词头"征兆"不合，释义存疑）
entries.en: doubtful: Chinese 屯市 (lit. storage/market, readings tûn-chŷ / tiûn-sȳ) does not correspond to Spanish agüero "omen"; gloss uncertain
entries.notes: 四栏互证失败：西语栏系重复词头 agüero，汉字栏"屯市"与征兆义无对应，按字面存疑记录

entries.zh: 凶兆（"掩心色"：令人心惊变色之兆）
entries.en: ill omen (lit. "countenance of a covered heart" — a sign that strikes fear into the heart)
entries.notes: 词头义（凶兆）由西语栏确定；汉字惯语"掩心色"字面"掩心之色"与其对应属推断

entries.zh: 岁礼、节礼（圣诞或新年馈赠之礼；汉字栏"威實"当为音写）
entries.en: aguinaldo, a gift given at Christmas or New Year
entries.notes: "威實"(úi-si̍t) 非汉语常词，判断为西语 aguinaldo 之音写而非义译，故降置信

entries.zh: 针灸（针刺与艾灸；西语栏谓"施'火钮'之针"，即以针行灸）
entries.en: acupuncture and moxibustion (the needle with which they apply burning moxa "buttons")
entries.notes: 西语"botones de fuego"即灸法之艾炷（火钮），与汉字"針灸"互证

entries.zh: 軛（车轭；与词头"打洞、凿洞"之义不合，释义存疑）
entries.en: doubtful: Spanish "agujero, haçello" (to bore/make a hole) does not correspond to Chinese 軛 "yoke" (readings uán / hiē-vārt); gloss uncertain
entries.notes: 四栏互证失败：haçello(hacerlo)义为"使成、打洞"，汉字"軛"（轭）及两栏对音无法与之对应，存疑

entries.zh: 谷（山谷、坑谷；西语栏作"小洞"，当指地上凹坑）
entries.en: valley, ravine; glossed in the Spanish column as "small hole/hollow"
entries.notes: 汉字与对音明确为"谷"；西语"小洞"当指坑谷之洼，此对应属推断

entries.en: cavity or chamber of the heart
